title: Asymptotic Uniformity of Permanents of Random Matrices over Finite Fields of Odd Characteristic
summary: Let $q$ be an odd prime power, and let $A_n=(a_{ij})\in\mathbb F_q^{n\times n}$ be a random matrix whose entries are independent and uniformly distributed on $\mathbb F_q$. The permanent of $A_n$ is defined by $\operatorname{per}(A_n)=\sum_{σ\in S_n}\prod_{i=1}^n a_{i,σ(i)}$, where $S_n$ denotes the symmetric group on $[n]$.
